title: "The LA Fire – A Terrifying Reminder of Eternal Realities" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The LA Fire – A Terrifying Reminder of Eternal Realities" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 The recent Los Angeles fire has left the world shaken.

Over 10 lives lost.
Nearly 10,000 structures destroyed.
Tens of thousands evacuated.
Billions of dollars in damage.
The images of flames engulfing homes, businesses, and entire communities have been overwhelming. As heartbreaking as this event is, it also reminds us of an even greater reality—a fire far worse than anything we’ve seen here on earth.
👉 What if this tragedy is a wake-up call for eternity?

🔥 The Reality of Judgment – A Fire That Never Dies
The devastation caused by the LA fires reminds us how fragile life can be. No one expected this disaster to strike, yet it came suddenly, consuming everything in its path.
📖 “For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ.” (2 Corinthians 5:10)

Hell is described as a place of eternal fire in the Bible:
📖 “And anyone not found written in the Book of Life was cast into the lake of fire.” (Revelation 20:15)
💡 The fire in LA will eventually burn out, but the fire of eternal separation from God never will.

🌍 What Are You Building Your Life On?
Many of the homes and businesses lost in the fire were once beautiful, expensive, and carefully built. Yet in an instant, they were reduced to ashes.
💡 The Bible warns us against building our lives on temporary things.

📖 “For no one can lay a foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ… If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw, their work will be shown for what it is.” (1 Corinthians 3:11-13)
✅ Eternal life isn't about material success, but your relationship with Jesus Christ.

🔥 The Urgency of Salvation – Don’t Wait for Disaster to Repent
💡 The suddenness of the LA fire reminds us how quickly life can change.
📖 “It is appointed for men to die once, and after this comes judgment.” (Hebrews 9:27)

The question is not if we will face death, but when.
👉 Are you prepared to stand before God?

🌟 The Good News: Jesus Paid the Price for You!
You don’t have to fear eternal separation from God.
Why? Because Jesus already took the punishment for your sins.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)

✅ Jesus died on the cross, absorbing the judgment you and I deserve.
✅ He rose again, conquering sin and death.
✅ Eternal life is now a free gift—not something you can earn.

❌ The Most Dangerous Lie: "I'll Do It Later"
The LA fire came without warning.
So does eternity.

Many think they have more time to get right with God.
But the Bible warns us:
📖 “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.” (Hebrews 3:15)

🌍 How to Be Saved Today (The Gospel Message)
The Bible makes it clear and simple:

✅ 1. Admit You’re a Sinner.
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

✅ 2. Believe Jesus Died for You and Rose Again.
📖 “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)

✅ 3. Trust in Christ Alone.
📖 “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.” (Romans 10:13)
👉 It’s not complicated. It’s Jesus alone.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 11, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose Jesus Christ as my Savior. I reject the temporary things of this world and place my faith fully in His finished work on the cross. Jesus, You are my only hope for eternity."

🔥 THE "ETERNAL WAKE-UP CALL" CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine Your Faith. Are you truly trusting Jesus?
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this truth today.

🌌 DON’T WAIT – CHOOSE JESUS TODAY 🌌
📖 “How shall we escape if we neglect so great a salvation?” (Hebrews 2:3)

The fire in Los Angeles was sudden and devastating.
👉 But there’s a far greater danger than losing earthly possessions—losing your soul.

🔥 Don’t wait for a personal disaster to seek Jesus.
Today is the day of salvation. (2 Corinthians 6:2)

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 11, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Today, I acknowledge the reality of eternity and the gift of salvation through Jesus Christ. I place my full trust in His finished work on the cross, knowing that only His sacrifice can save me. Thank You for the free gift of eternal life. Keep my heart focused on what truly matters.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
